what_this_is: The canonical definition of every quantity in this repository whose value could change a verdict, a gate, or a claim. One definition per quantity, cross-referenced from wherever it is used, so the same number cannot drift into two values. This is NOT an inventory of every literal: incidental constants (ports, retry counts, buffer sizes) are deliberately absent.
consequential_test: A quantity belongs here if changing it could change a run's verdict, a property's outcome, whether a claim is supportable, or whether the apparatus is judged valid.

provenance.requirement: imposed by the owner or by scope; not derived from anything in the repository
provenance.sourced: read from PX4 source, vendor documentation or a standard, with a locator
provenance.measured_input: measured from the apparatus and used as an input to something else
provenance.calculated: derived from other quantities in this register by a stated model
provenance.selected: chosen by us; the choice is defensible but not forced by any of the above
provenance.measured_result: observed in a run; an outcome, not an input
provenance.provisional: a placeholder that has no support yet and is marked for resolution

evidence_status.frozen: fixed before the runs it judges and not revisable against them
evidence_status.unresolved: no support yet; the dependent conclusion is open
evidence_status.superseded: kept for the record; no longer in force

quantities.name: development timing tolerance
quantities.rationale: Frozen before the runs as three times the repeat range then available (Q-REPEAT-OLD). That multiplier is not a validation, and the basis has since been corrected.
quantities.what_it_is_not: Not an accuracy bound and not derived from Q-REPEAT-NEW. Re-deriving it from the runs it judges would be fitting. Distinct from Study A's proposed 0.2 s median / 1.0 s p95.
quantities.sensitivity: a wider value suppresses false alarms and hides real deviations equally
quantities.validation: none possible from these runs; a future protocol version may calibrate prospectively

quantities.name: repeat range used to set the tolerance
quantities.rationale: range of horizon_reached over the 2026-09-20 control repeats, computed through the pre-repair clock
quantities.what_it_is_not: not measured on the vehicle's own clock; it folded per-run offset-estimation variance in
quantities.sensitivity: n/a
quantities.validation: superseded by Q-REPEAT-NEW

quantities.name: repeat-to-repeat range, vehicle clock
used_by: nothing; it is reported, not consumed
quantities.rationale: range of horizon_reached across n=4 valid control repeats, re-derived on vehicle_observation stamps
quantities.what_it_is_not: NOT accuracy, NOT a tail bound, NOT a bound on injection-relative latency error. Four repeats of one scenario say how far that scenario moved, nothing more.
quantities.sensitivity: unknown; no tail was estimated
quantities.validation: observed; would need a calibration design to become a bound

quantities.name: update and transport residual on any latency
quantities.rationale: The injection instant is a cached telemetry stamp with no defensible upper bound, so no total deadline can be formed. The source-controlled part is derivable; this part is not.
quantities.what_it_is_not: not zero, and not to be assumed small
quantities.sensitivity: dominates: while unresolved, no timing verdict in this rig can pass
quantities.validation: needs a transport or timebase bound, or a causally post-event acknowledgment

quantities.name: oscillation window
quantities.rationale: COM_DL_LOSS_T's default (Q-DL-LOSS-T) motivates the magnitude
quantities.what_it_is_not: NOT derived and NOT literature-validated. No source justifies 10 s as an oscillation window, and a paper using another window validates nothing here.
quantities.sensitivity: a shorter window misses slow flapping; a longer one admits legitimate escalation
quantities.validation: none; it is a study parameter and is labelled as one

quantities.name: U4 observation margin
used_by: U4, only once Q-RESIDUAL is resolved
quantities.rationale: two MAVLink heartbeat periods at 1 Hz [B5]
quantities.what_it_is_not: A heartbeat period is the resolution of ONE observation route. It is not the resolution of a battery, estimator or selector event, and it does not substitute for Q-RESIDUAL.
quantities.sensitivity: small next to the unresolved residual
quantities.validation: inert while U4's deadline is not_yet_evaluable

quantities.name: observation horizon after injection
quantities.rationale: Must exceed the longest predicted response: detection 10 s plus hold delay 5 s plus the RTL manoeuvre. 45 s leaves margin over the 15 s predicted transition in T1.
quantities.what_it_is_not: not derived from a completion model; no completion deadline exists (see U4)
quantities.sensitivity: too short would report a false absence of recovery
quantities.validation: partially observed: the 2026-09-23 run held its mode for the full horizon, so the horizon was not the limiting factor in that absence

quantities.name: nominal injection time on the vehicle clock
quantities.rationale: after takeoff and settling (observed around 18 s) with margin, so the stimulus lands in steady flight
quantities.what_it_is_not: not the observed injection instant; the realised value is recorded per run and differs
quantities.sensitivity: too early risks injection_before_takeoff, which invalidates the run
quantities.validation: observed: realised injections landed at 55.4 to 58.1 s vehicle time, all after takeoff

quantities.name: per-seed injection offsets
quantities.rationale: deliberately spread the stimulus across the framework's update phase
quantities.what_it_is_not: NOT independent random worlds. SIH is deterministic given the same parameters, so these are designed coverage offsets and carry no sampling interpretation.
quantities.sensitivity: an offset smaller than the update period would not discriminate phase
quantities.validation: none; the interpretation, not the values, was the defect

quantities.name: heartbeat gap that invalidates a run
quantities.rationale: two missed 1 Hz heartbeats [B5]; a shorter gap is ordinary scheduling
quantities.what_it_is_not: not the MAVLink link-loss convention of four to five missed beats, which is about the vehicle's own detection
quantities.sensitivity: too tight would invalidate healthy runs; too loose would admit a stalled simulator
quantities.validation: observed: one 2026-09-20 control repeat was correctly marked simulator_crash by it

quantities.name: commanded takeoff altitude
quantities.rationale: high enough to be clear of ground effect and the land detector, low enough to keep the RTL climb short
quantities.what_it_is_not: not a requirement; no property depends on the value
quantities.sensitivity: low: it changes manoeuvre duration, which no live deadline uses
quantities.validation: observed: takeoff_complete fired at around 18 s in every valid run

quantities.name: takeoff settle test
used_by: takeoff_complete, which opens a control run's response window
quantities.rationale: within 1 m of the commanded altitude and nearly stationary vertically
quantities.what_it_is_not: not the autopilot's own notion of takeoff complete. PX4 leaves AUTO_TAKEOFF slightly later, which is why T6 expects one AUTO_LOITER transition inside the control window.
quantities.sensitivity: a tighter test would delay the window and move that transition outside it
quantities.validation: observed: the offset between this test and the nav_state change is visible in the 2026-09-23 run

quantities.name: minimum runs for a reproducibility statistic
quantities.rationale: a range needs two values; below that there is nothing to report
quantities.what_it_is_not: NOT a sufficient sample for any inference. Two runs give a range and no distribution.
quantities.sensitivity: raising it would suppress the current four-repeat report entirely
quantities.validation: n/a

quantities.name: literature title match threshold
quantities.rationale: Tuned to separate a paraphrase from a different work. L43 scored 0.188 against its true title and was caught; every correct entry scored above the threshold.
quantities.what_it_is_not: NOT able to catch L32, whose recorded title matched its wrong identifier exactly. That class of error needs the human intent audit.
quantities.sensitivity: 51 of 55 rows currently match; a stricter value would flag correct entries
quantities.validation: observed over all 55 rows: 1 true positive, 0 false positives

quantities.name: oracle job time budget
quantities.rationale: one focused attempt; a longer hunt is a new decision rather than a retry
quantities.what_it_is_not: not an estimate of how long a PX4 build takes on this runner; no such build has been observed
quantities.sensitivity: a timeout is an environment result and is recorded as one
quantities.validation: observed 2026-09-26: the build and full test run took 9 minutes wall clock against the 60-minute budget (run 36222455516), so the budget is generous and was not the limiting factor

quantities.name: COM_FAIL_ACT_T, the hold-delay parameter
quantities.rationale: vendor default
quantities.what_it_is_not: not a requirement; the matrix also runs it at 0.0
quantities.sensitivity: T2 exists precisely to vary it
quantities.validation: read back from the vehicle in every run

quantities.name: COM_DL_LOSS_T, datalink detection timeout
used_by: T1, T2 and T5 predicted hazard times
quantities.rationale: vendor default
quantities.what_it_is_not: not the deadline for a response; it is spent BEFORE the flag rises and must not be counted twice
quantities.sensitivity: the predicted hazard time moves with it
quantities.validation: observed at 11.4 to 12.0 s against a predicted 10.0 s; the discrepancy is real and its cause is unresolved, and the timing verdict is now inconclusive rather than refuted

quantities.name: delay-pot recharge rate
quantities.rationale: PX4's own comment: increase the delay slower than it is reduced, so a toggling condition still acts at some point.
quantities.what_it_is_not: not a tunable of ours; changing it would make the model disagree with the implementation
quantities.sensitivity: it is the whole mechanism the interaction study targets
quantities.validation: transcription self-check only; the native oracle has not confirmed it. Unchanged by the 2026-09-26 oracle run: PX4's own suite passing is not a comparison against this transcription, and no such comparison has been made

quantities.name: threshold below which no hold delay applies
quantities.rationale: the implementation's own guard
quantities.what_it_is_not: not chosen by us
quantities.sensitivity: T2's whole prediction turns on it
quantities.validation: transcription self-check only. Unchanged by the 2026-09-26 oracle run: PX4's own suite passing is not a comparison against this transcription, and no such comparison has been made

quantities.name: GCS heartbeat rate
quantities.rationale: protocol convention
quantities.what_it_is_not: The resolution of ONE observation route. It does not set the time resolution of every battery, estimator or selector event, and a universal heartbeat margin was a defect.
quantities.sensitivity: the heartbeat mode source is superseded by the autopilot log where available
quantities.validation: observed in every capture

quantities.name: Wilson and exact bounds quoted in the review
used_by: the argument that D7's old pooled gate was unsupportable
quantities.rationale: recomputed independently and they agree with the owner's figures to the digits quoted
quantities.what_it_is_not: These are illustrations under an explicit binomial assumption. The deterministic case matrix is not a Bernoulli sample and no interval applies to it.
quantities.sensitivity: n/a
quantities.validation: arithmetic verified in session
